items.title: MiniMax rounds up community quants that run M3.1 Flash locally, including a single DGX Spark recipe
items.summary: MiniMax lists the community quantizations and recipes for its 428B M3.1 Flash: Unsloth 2-bit dynamic GGUFs at 143.9 GB, a SAGE-EXL3 quant with token-level fidelity measurements sized for one DGX Spark, EXL3-EAQ quants, oQ quants with DSpark decoding through oMLX on Apple Silicon, AMD Quark MXFP4 for Instinct GPUs, and a 4x RTX 3090 setup that mixes quantized weights, expert caching and system RAM. The Unsloth GGUFs were covered on Oct 26; the Spark, MLX and AMD paths are new.

doubt.pushback: A roundup post with no links of its own; @ViC305 confirms the single-Spark SAGE-EXL3 quant but his Hugging Face link did not resolve outside X.

items.reception: Builders thank MiniMax for crediting community work; replies ask for speed numbers on each setup.

items.title: opencode's GitHub triage runs in one long-lived session where specialized subagents emerge on their own
items.summary: Dax Raad says opencode's GitHub issue triage runs from a single long-running opencode session. Because the session hands new work to subagents that handled similar issues before, specialized subagents form without being designed, and his screenshot shows one that has become the Linux-specific helper.

doubt.pushback: Single screenshot from the builder; no write-up or config shared.

items.reception: Replies ask how context growth is kept in check over a session that runs for days.

items.title: Qwen Image 2.1 Realtime Space moves to a v1.5 two-step distill LoRA with better quality at the same speed
items.summary: Hugging Face's Linoy Tsaban updated her realtime Qwen Image 2.1 demo to v1.5 of her two-step distillation LoRA, which she says improves image quality at the same speed. It runs in real time on Hugging Face ZeroGPU, and the Space is public.
items.reception: Small but positive; few replies so far.
